# Paperclip Studio

> Paperclip Studio is an innovative South African web design studio. It designs
> custom websites and landing pages for businesses in Cape Town, Johannesburg
> (Joburg), Durban, Pretoria and across South Africa. Every site is designed by
> hand and built with the help of AI tools, which is how the studio delivers
> in 3–7 working days. Sites are built on Next.js and React and hosted on Vercel.
> Based in South Africa, working remotely with clients nationwide.

Paperclip Studio is run by Lucia. The studio builds three things: single-page
landing pages aimed at paid traffic, full 3–5 page business websites, and
premium builds that pair a website with a dedicated ads landing page and
conversion tracking. Add-on services include logo design, POPIA compliance
setup, Google Business Profile setup, tracking and pixel installation, domain
and hosting setup, and monthly maintenance.

The studio works only with service-based businesses (trades, salons,
consultants, guesthouses, tourism, events, professional practices). It does
not build e-commerce websites or online shops.

Pricing is quoted per project rather than published. Every quote is a fixed
price against a defined scope, with a 50% deposit and the balance on delivery.
Two rounds of revisions are included.

## Guides

- [How much does a website cost in South Africa?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/how-much-does-a-website-cost-in-south-africa): What South African businesses actually pay across DIY builders, freelancers, studios and agencies, and what each option gets you.
- [AI website builder vs hiring a web designer](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/ai-website-builder-vs-hiring-web-designer-south-africa): An honest comparison of AI builders and human designers for South African small businesses.
- [POPIA and your website](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/popia-compliance-for-small-business-websites): What South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act requires from a small business website — privacy policy, consent, cookies and contact forms.
- [Getting your business on Google Maps in South Africa](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/get-your-business-on-google-maps-south-africa): Claiming and ranking a Google Business Profile, including verification and reviews.

- [Do I need a website if I have a Facebook page?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/do-i-need-a-website-if-i-have-facebook): When a social page is enough and when it quietly costs a business work.
- [Why isn't my website getting any enquiries?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/why-is-my-website-not-getting-enquiries): Diagnosing a traffic problem versus a conversion problem.
- [Why your business needs an online presence](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/why-your-business-needs-an-online-presence): Website, Google Business Profile and reviews, and what each one does.
- [Who actually owns your website?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/who-owns-your-website-domain-and-hosting): Domains, hosting and logins, and how to check you control them.
- [7 signs your business website is costing you customers](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/signs-your-business-website-needs-a-redesign): A checklist for deciding whether a website needs a fix or a redesign.
- [Landing page or full website?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/landing-page-vs-website): What each one is for and how businesses use both.
- [What a tradesperson's website needs to win more jobs](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/website-for-tradespeople-south-africa): One-tap contact, services, areas covered and proof, for South African trades.
- [What is AI-assisted web design?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/what-is-ai-assisted-web-design): How a studio uses AI tools in practice and what is still done by a person.
- [What pages does a service business website need?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/pages-a-service-business-website-needs): The five pages that win enquiries and what goes on each.
- [Service website or online shop?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/service-website-vs-ecommerce-store): How service websites and e-commerce stores differ, and which a business needs.
- [How long does it take to build a website in South Africa?](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/how-long-does-it-take-to-build-a-website): Realistic timelines by type of builder, and what speeds a project up or slows it down.
- [How to choose a web designer in South Africa](https://www.paperclipstudio.co.za/blog/how-to-choose-a-web-designer-south-africa): Ten questions to ask before hiring, and red flags to avoid.
